scope: rotateAccountCredentials (the OpenCode credential refresh path) updates the request-path credential cache, so requests are no longer signed with the access token the rotation just revoked (root cause of the 2026-11-21T02:06:40Z 'OAuth access token has been revoked' errors).

A 401 response gets exactly one retry for the SAME account: a newer token this process already holds, else a newer token in that account's own credential store (the rejected token is never adopted), else one refresh through the locked, single-flight, cooldown-aware rotateAccountCredentials path. No other account, API key or CLI; never a second retry.
400, 429, 529 and every other failed response are still returned without retry.
Each 401 recovery appends a claude_auth_recovery event (outcome, how, status, retry status, model) to <HARNESS_STATE_DIR>/telemetry/token-saving.jsonl; no token or header value is written.
